description:
Get Booking.com guest reviews (scores out of 10, what guests liked and disliked, the
        property's reply), with filters for sort, language, score band, traveller type, season,
        text and dates.

        Cost: 1 credit per call, up to 25 reviews; the next page is a new call with `cursor`.
        A call with no reviews but a `next_cursor` is free. Guests are anonymous.

        Args:
            hotel_id: Numeric id ('537945') or handle ('fr-ibis-budget-paris-porte-de-bercy').
            sort: 'relevant' (default), 'recent', 'oldest', 'highest', 'lowest'.
            language: ISO 639-1 code ('en').
            score: Score band: 'superb' (9+), 'good' (7-9), 'passable' (5-7), 'poor' (3-5),
                'very_poor' (1-3).
            traveler_type: 'families', 'couples', 'groups', 'solo', 'business'.
            season: Season of the stay.
            search: Text the review must contain (max 100 characters).
            since: Published on/after, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            until: Published on/before, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            limit: Reviews to return, 1-25.
            cursor: `next_cursor` of the previous call (same filters).
name: booking_get_reviews
title: Get Booking.com reviews
